body:
Customers ask us many of the same questions before they order, and many of the answers are scattered across policy pages and guides. This page collects the most common questions about ordering from One Stop Vape Store in one place, with direct answers and links to the longer articles. It covers who can buy, the minimum order, shipping costs and times, signatures, payments, discounts, tracking, returns, wholesale and support, and a few questions about products. It is written for adults aged 21 and over. Nicotine is addictive, and nothing here is medical advice. If your question is not here, our contact details are at the end.

## Ordering basics
### Who can order?
Adults aged 21 and over. You confirm your age at the age gate, and an adult must sign for delivery with ID. See [what 21+ age verification means](/blog/what-21-plus-age-verification-means/).

### What is the minimum order?
The minimum order is $100 before shipping. Many customers meet it by choosing two or three devices or a pack. See [minimum order and free shipping explained](/blog/minimum-order-and-free-shipping-explained/).

### Is shipping free?
Orders of $200 or more after discount ship free. Smaller orders pay a flat fee of $15. The discount for cryptocurrency and gift cards is applied before the free-shipping check.

### Can I choose a strength or pack size?
Yes. Use the selector on the product page. The price updates for each option, and your cart shows each option as its own line. See [how to read a vape product page](/blog/how-to-read-a-vape-product-page/).

## Shipping and delivery
### How long does delivery take?
Orders are processed in 24 to 72 business hours. Transit by regional carrier then takes about 3 to 7 business days to Arizona, Nevada, Washington and Idaho, and about 11 to 18 business days to the eastern half of the country. See [shipping times from Phoenix](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/).

### Do I have to sign?
Yes. An adult aged 21 or over must sign with ID. If no one is home, the carrier will try again or hold the parcel. See [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/).

### Can I ship to a PO box or workplace?
Carriers and rules may restrict PO boxes for these products. Use an address where an adult can sign. See [shipping address tips](/blog/shipping-address-tips/).

### Can I track my order?
Yes. You receive an order ID, and tracking is provided when your parcel ships. See [how to track your order](/blog/how-to-track-your-order/).

### Do you ship everywhere?
We ship to most of the contiguous United States. Some states and cities restrict products or flavors, and we cannot ship where it is not allowed. Check your local rules. See [state and local vape laws explained](/blog/state-and-local-vape-laws-explained/).

## Payments
### Which payment methods do you accept?
Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, cryptocurrency and gift cards. See [payment methods compared](/blog/payment-methods-compared/).

### Is there a discount?
Yes: 10 percent for cryptocurrency and gift card payments. See [how the crypto discount works](/blog/crypto-discount-how-it-works/).

### Where do I get the payment details?
For Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime, we send them after you place your order. For cryptocurrency, you are shown a public wallet address. See [how payment details reach you](/blog/how-payment-details-reach-you/).

### Which cryptocurrencies do you accept?
Bitcoin, Tether, USDC, Ethereum, BNB and Solana. See [crypto payment FAQ](/blog/crypto-payment-faq/).

### Which gift cards do you accept?
Apple, Razer, Paysafe, Sephora and Macy's. See [how gift card payment works](/blog/how-gift-card-payment-works/).

### Do you ask for card numbers?
We never ask for private keys, seed phrases or passwords in messages.

### How do I upload a payment screenshot?
Follow the steps on your order payment page. See [how to upload a payment screenshot](/blog/how-to-upload-a-payment-screenshot/).

## Returns and refunds
### Can I return an item?
Within 30 days, with an RMA, for unopened items. Opened or used items cannot be returned. A 15 percent restocking fee applies. Refunds go back through the original payment method. Puffco products are excluded. See [refund and return policy explained](/blog/refund-and-return-policy-explained/) and the [refund policy](/refunds/).

### What if my order arrives damaged or wrong?
Contact us with your order ID and photos. We will tell you what applies.

## Wholesale and business
### Do you offer wholesale?
Yes, for qualified business customers. See the [wholesale ordering guide](/blog/wholesale-ordering-guide/).

## Products
### What do you sell?
Disposable vapes, vape juice and nicotine salts, kits, vaporizers, coils and pods, nicotine pouches and Nixodine devices. See [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) and [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/).

### How do I choose a strength?
Start low, and read the label. See [nicotine strength guide](/blog/nicotine-strength-guide/).

### How do I choose a first device?
See [best vapes for beginners](/blog/best-vapes-for-beginners-21-plus/).

### Are puff counts exact?
No. They are maker estimates. See [puff counts explained](/blog/puff-count-explained/).

### Are you affiliated with the brands you sell?
We are a retailer, and we sell products made by other companies.

### Do you make health claims?
No. Nicotine is addictive, and products are for adults only. Speak to a healthcare professional about health questions.

## Care and troubleshooting
### How do I charge a disposable?
See [how to charge a disposable](/blog/how-to-charge-a-disposable/).

### Why is my vape not hitting?
See [why is my vape not hitting](/blog/why-is-my-vape-not-hitting/).

### How do I dispose of a vape?
See [how to dispose of vapes and batteries](/blog/how-to-dispose-of-vapes-and-batteries/).

### How do I store products?
Cool, dry, upright and away from children and pets. See [how to store disposable vapes](/blog/how-to-store-disposable-vapes/).

## Contacting us
### Who do I contact?
Use the [contact page](/contact/), email sales@onestopvapestore.com or call 774-734-1372. Include your order ID, the product name and a short description. See [how to contact support](/blog/how-to-contact-support/) and the [FAQ](/faq/).

### Where are you based?
4908 E McDowell Road, Suite 103, Phoenix, Arizona 85008. We are operated by SV3 LLC and were established in December 2022.

## Shop
Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) and [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## More questions we hear
### Can I change my order after I place it?
Contact us as soon as possible with your order ID. If the order has not been processed, we will tell you what can be changed. Once it has shipped, it cannot be changed.

### What if the carrier cannot deliver?
Carriers need an adult to sign. If no one is available, they usually try again or hold the parcel for collection. Keep your tracking details, and contact the carrier or us if the parcel is delayed. See [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/).

### Why did my payment show as underpaid?
For cryptocurrency, network fees or price movements can leave an amount short. We tell you what is outstanding. See [why your crypto payment shows underpaid](/blog/why-your-crypto-payment-shows-underpaid/).

### How do you detect crypto payments?
We watch the public address for your order and match the amount and network. See [how we detect your crypto payment](/blog/how-we-detect-your-crypto-payment/).

### How does Cash App payment work?
We send you the payment details after you place your order, and you send the amount, then confirm. See [Cash App payments guide](/blog/cash-app-payments-guide/), [Apple Pay payments guide](/blog/apple-pay-payments-guide/) and [Chime payments guide](/blog/chime-payments-guide/).

### What is a nicotine pouch?
A small pad placed between the lip and gum, with no vapor and no device. See [nicotine pouches for adult beginners](/blog/nicotine-pouches-beginners-guide/).

### What is Nixodine?
A term some brands use for an ingredient in certain devices. See [what is Nixodine](/blog/what-is-nixodine/).

### Do you offer samples?
We sell single units in many cases, which is a way to try a flavor before buying more. Check the product page for options.

### Can I buy as a gift?
Products are for adults aged 21 and over only, and an adult must sign for delivery. Do not give them to anyone under 21.

### Can someone else sign for my parcel?
Any adult aged 21 or over with ID may sign. See the shipping policy for details.

### What should I do if my parcel is late?
Check your tracking, allow for the transit times listed above and contact us with your order ID if it is well beyond the estimate. See [how to track your order](/blog/how-to-track-your-order/).

### Where can I read your policies?
Our [shipping](/shipping/), [refund](/refunds/), [privacy](/privacy/) and [terms](/terms/) pages are linked in the footer, along with our [FDA disclaimer](/fda-disclaimer/) and [PACT Act page](/pact-act/).

### Can I see your address?
Yes. 4908 E McDowell Road, Suite 103, Phoenix, Arizona 85008. The operator is SV3 LLC, and the business was established in December 2022.

### How do I know the prices are right?
The server checks every price when you check out. What you see in the cart is what you are charged, apart from any discount for cryptocurrency or gift cards, which is shown at checkout.

## Still not sure?
If your question is not covered here, check the [FAQ](/faq/) page, the [shipping policy](/shipping/) and the [refund policy](/refunds/), which go into more detail than a summary can. For anything about a specific order, contact us with your order ID, the product name and a short description of what you need, and add a photo or short video if it helps. We answer from our policies and product data, and if we do not know something, we will say so instead of guessing. Remember that all products are for adults aged 21 and over, and that nicotine is addictive.

## A tip for first-time buyers
Read the product page, choose your strength and pack size, check the cart line by line and confirm that the total meets the $100 minimum. Choose a payment method you are comfortable with, keep your confirmations and make sure an adult will be available to sign when the parcel arrives. These small steps prevent most of the problems that customers ask us about.
